title: Derive packet migration parity from the bundle preset catalog instead of a nonexistent single dataset
description: Stage 2 registry defect: the packet:customer-report-packet registry entry carries DatasetKey 'customer-report-packet', which has no registered IReportConfigurationDatasetProvider anywhere, so ReportMigrationRegistry.DeriveParityAsync always gets null from GetDatasetAsync and the entry is stuck at 'pending' forever even though ERP-310 migrated the packet as a multi-section bundle preset (sales-order + receivable sections) keyed to packet:customer-report-packet. The registry only consults the single-dataset preset catalog (IReportMigrationPresetCatalog) and never the bundle preset catalog (IReportConfigurationBundlePresetCatalog), so bundle-based migrations are invisible to parity derivation and to CanRetireLegacyRoutes. Fix DeriveParityAsync (and constructor/DI) to recognize bundle-composed entries: when the single dataset is absent, resolve the bundle preset with the same LegacyKey via IReportConfigurationBundlePresetCatalog and derive parity from its section dataset readiness (all sections dataset-ready -> dataset-ready/preset-ready; any missing/revoked section stays pending), preserving fail-closed behavior and never deriving parity-passed from declarations alone. No new controller/designer/exporter, no arbitrary SQL, no schema/seed/migration changes, no secrets/env, no permission expansion; only the registry parity path plus tests. Not audit-only: this makes the packet entry's parity and legacy-route gate actually functional.
acceptance_criteria: ReportMigrationRegistry derives the packet:customer-report-packet entry from the ERP-310 bundle preset (LegacyKey packet:customer-report-packet) via IReportConfigurationBundlePresetCatalog when the single dataset 'customer-report-packet' is absent, so the entry reaches at least dataset-ready/preset-ready when its sales-order and receivable sections are authorized and ready, and stays pending when any section dataset is missing or revoked.

The bundle-aware parity path rechecks every section's dataset menu/current-user authorization fail-closed per request, never trusts the bundle preset payload, never marks parity-passed without the existing four-dimension comparison evidence, and does not regress the single-dataset parity derivation for the other registry entries.

Add executable unit coverage in ReportMigrationRegistryTests (with a bundle preset stub) asserting the packet entry leaves pending and reaches preset-ready as sections become ready, revoked/missing sections fail closed, and CanRetireLegacyRoutes still requires parity evidence. Run related tests plus the safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Application/DTOs/ReportMigrationRegistryDtos.cs:250-252 declares packet:customer-report-packet with DatasetKey='customer-report-packet', but no provider registers that key (src/ERP.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs:69-103 registers only real single-dataset providers). src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportMigrationRegistry.cs:100-106 DeriveParityAsync returns Pending when GetDatasetAsync(definition.DatasetKey) is null and only consults IReportMigrationPresetCatalog.HasPresetAsync, so the packet can never leave pending. The bundle preset exists and is keyed to the same LegacyKey: src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportConfigurationBundlePresetCatalog.cs:61-99 ('customer-report-packet', LegacyKey 'packet:customer-report-packet', sections sales-order + receivable) and src/ERP.Application/Interfaces/IReportConfigurationBundlePresetCatalog.cs:14-27 exposes GetPresetAsync/ListPresetsAsync returning ReportConfigurationBundlePresetDto (LegacyKey/Readiness/Sections[].DatasetKey, src/ERP.Application/DTOs/ReportConfigurationBundlePresetDtos.cs:70-123). Registry constructor at ReportMigrationRegistry.cs:22-32 does not receive IReportConfigurationBundlePresetCatalog.
